notes: Read from a Teltonika FMB001 attached in the same session (the vehicle
does not broadcast its VIN on this bus, so it came from the device's
OBD-II read rather than from the capture).
Only characters 1-9 are stored: manufacturer + model/body/powertrain.
The unit-identifying tail is deliberately omitted.
CAUTION: position 10 is 'S', which ISO 3779 reads as model year 2025,
while this pack's folder says Petrol_2023 (from the 2026-06-13 capture
that created it). Either the folder year is wrong or these are two
different model years sharing one bus map - the pack's three original
signals decode correctly on BOTH capture sets, so the map is shared
either way. Resolve before trusting the folder name.
